verdict.rationale: Dialpad is a business phone platform, so number provisioning is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers searching available numbers by area code or buying a local number. The cited docs cover recordings, webhooks, call control, blocking numbers and MCP, none of which is number search or purchase.

support.subject: As a founder, I can search available numbers by area code and buy a local number in minutes
